turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm doing the big grocery run for the week.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice. Do you have a list or are you winging it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Let's plan a bit. What are you cooking for dinners this week?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Excuse me for a moment, my friend has a question. Don't talk until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you going to the book club on Thursday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I want to, but I'm only halfway through the book.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Same. It's so slow in the middle.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Right? Pages and pages about the weather.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we just go and listen? Nobody will mind.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: True, and there's always cake. Let's go.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back again. What were we talking about?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. We were planning your dinners before the grocery run.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Tacos, a stir fry, and probably pasta twice.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Easy list then. Tortillas, ground meat, veggies, rice, soy sauce, and two kinds of pasta sauce.
